title: WASD Materials
cue: materials by name, no textures or UVs: bricks, wood, metal
summary: Materials by name with no texture files and no UV maps: concrete, bricks, planks, metal, rock, and more; right materials and cut-outs from downloaded textures; toon with outlines, glass, glow, skin.
useWhen: Meshes, CSG shapes, or generated geometry would otherwise wear flat colors: a gray-box level, buildings, props, terrain. Also to turn a Poly Haven or ambientCG texture folder or one picture into a correct material, for leaf and decal cut-outs, a toon look, glass, glow, and human skin, eyes, hair.
avoidWhen: Every model already comes textured from Blender or a download and nothing else needs a surface; or the game is 2D.
